classification.difficultyReason: Identify the remaining portion of the journey, then calculate a percentage of that portion.

content.prompt: If you travel from Goatshead to Oxtail, you have covered $45\%$ of the total distance between the two towns when you reach the turnoff. The bridge is $60\%$ of the way from the turnoff to Oxtail. What percentage of the total trip still remains when you get to the bridge?

spec.description: Schematic winding route, read left to right: Goatshead, turnoff with an upward branch, bridge, Oxtail. Endpoint markers and all four location labels are retained. Decorative blue route and red endpoints are rendered in house black.
spec.mathematics: The turnoff is 45% of the total journey from Goatshead; the bridge is 60% of the remaining journey from the turnoff to Oxtail. The drawing supplies location order rather than measurable distances.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied route and location labels are visible; no calculated percentages are shown.

answer.short:
$22\%$ of the total trip.

Find the portion remaining after the turnoff, then take $40\%$ of that portion.
answer.worked:
From the turnoff to Oxtail:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Percentage of total trip} &= 100\%-45\% \\ \text{Percentage of total trip} &= 55\%\end{align*}$$
The bridge leaves $100\%-60\%=40\%$ of this section still to travel.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Percentage of total trip remaining} &= \frac{40}{100}\times55\% \\ \text{Percentage of total trip remaining} &= 22\%\end{align*}$$
